traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your ability scores each increase by 1.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Humans vary widely in height and build, from barely 5 feet to well over 6 feet tall. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Versatility
traits.text: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: You can speak, read, and write Common and one extra language of your choice. Humans typically learn the languages of other peoples they deal with, including obscure dialects.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Charisma score increases by 1 (for a total of +2 to Charisma).

traits.name: Social Intuition
traits.text: You have proficiency in the Persuasion skill. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Deception, Insight, or Intimidation.

traits.name: Diplomatic Training
traits.text: You know one additional language of your choice.

traits.name: Natural Leader
traits.text: Once per short rest, when you or an ally within 30 feet of you rolls a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can call out a warning or offer quick advice, allowing the roll to be rerolled. The second roll must be used.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Constitution score increases by 1, and your Wisdom score increases by 1 (for a total of +2 to Constitution and +2 to Wisdom).

traits.name: Environmental Adaptation
traits.text: You have advantage on saving throws against extreme heat and cold.

traits.name: Survival Instinct
traits.text: You have proficiency in the Survival skill. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Medicine, or Nature.

traits.name: Wayfinder
traits.text: You always know which way is north, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to avoid becoming lost.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Intelligence score increases by 1 (for a total of +2 to Intelligence).

traits.name: Knowledge Seeker
traits.text: You have proficiency in the History skill. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Arcana, Investigation, or Religion.

traits.name: Quick Learner
traits.text: You gain proficiency with one set of tools of your choice.

traits.name: Lore Master
traits.text: When you make an Intelligence check to recall information about something you've studied, you can add double your proficiency bonus instead of any proficiency bonus you normally apply.

backgroundSource.name: Battlefield Medic

source.text: Tool Proficiencies: Healer's kit, Herbalism kit
Equipment: A healer's kit, a bloodstained bandana or token from your service, a journal containing medical notes and sketches, a set of common clothes, and a pouch containing 10 gp.

Feature: Trauma Response: Your battlefield experience has honed your emergency medical skills. When you use a healer's kit to stabilize a dying creature, they regain 1 hit point immediately. Additionally, you can identify the nature and severity of injuries at a glance. Your service grants you Liked starting Reputation with veterans of the conflict you served in but Neutral starting Reputation with those who fought on the opposing side.

selectedBardCards.name: Verse of Courage
selectedBardCards.target: One enemy; one other ally within 30 feet
selectedBardCards.effect: Make a performance attack against one enemy. On a hit, deal S d6 psychic damage. Whether you hit or miss, choose one other ally within 30 feet; its next successful weapon attack before the end of your next turn deals +1 damage. The encouragement does not stack with itself.
selectedBardCards.crescendoRider: The encouraged ally also gains advantage on its next saving throw before the end of your next turn. No additional damage is copied by an Echo.
selectedBardCards.scaling: Bard class level determines S. C=max(1, Charisma modifier). Attacks and save DC use ordinary total-character proficiency.

source.originalText: Verse of Courage: A quick musical phrase that deals minor damage to a single target and grants +5% damage to an ally for 2 turns.

selectedBardCards.name: Chant of Renewal
selectedBardCards.target: One living ally per pulse, including yourself
selectedBardCards.effect: On starting and on each paid maintenance pulse, one living ally within 15 feet regains 1d6+C HP. You may choose a different ally each pulse. There are at most 3 pulses, including the initial pulse. A creature can benefit from this named Chant only once per round across all Bards. This never removes Wounds or restores life.
selectedBardCards.crescendoRider: The initial recipient also gains C temporary HP for 1 round; subsequent pulses are unchanged.
selectedBardCards.scaling: Bard class level determines S. C=max(1, Charisma modifier). Attacks and save DC use ordinary total-character proficiency.

source.originalText: Chant of Renewal: A sustained melody that heals nearby allies for a small amount each turn while maintained.

selectedBardCards.name: Dissonant Note
selectedBardCards.resolution: Wisdom; then Constitution concentration if applicable
selectedBardCards.effect: The enemy makes a Wisdom save. On failure it loses its Reaction until the start of your next turn. If it is concentrating, it also makes a Constitution concentration save against your performance DC; failure ends its sustained effect. Success on the Wisdom save prevents both effects.
selectedBardCards.crescendoRider: Beginning at Bard class level 5, if the Wisdom save fails by 10 or more, the target is also Stunned until the end of its next turn. A natural 1 alone does not substitute for this margin.
selectedBardCards.scaling: Bard class level determines S. C=max(1, Charisma modifier). Attacks and save DC use ordinary total-character proficiency.

source.originalText: Dissonant Note: A jarring sound that interrupts enemy concentration and has a chance to briefly stun.

selectedBardCards.name: Echo of Inspiration
selectedBardCards.target: One original target of one eligible source
selectedBardCards.effect: Create one pending Echo package using the immediate, unmodified damage OR healing dice of one eligible performance you resolved this turn or on your previous turn. At the start of your next turn, repeat 50% of that stored dice total, rounded down, to one of its original affected targets still within 30 feet. A positive fraction has minimum 1. Apply current resistance/immunity to damage and the ordinary missing-HP limit to healing.
selectedBardCards.crescendoRider: Increase the copied fraction by 25 percentage points, subject to the 100% package cap. This copies no Crescendo rider or other trigger.
selectedBardCards.scaling: Bard class level determines S. C=max(1, Charisma modifier). Attacks and save DC use ordinary total-character proficiency.

source.originalText: Echo of Inspiration: Amplifies your last performed ability, causing its effects to repeat at 50% potency next turn.

selectedOrdinarySpells.name: Shield

operational.activation: Reaction — when the chosen creature is targeted by an attack roll or Magic Missile, before the attack or damage resolves
operational.targets: Self or one willing creature you can perceive within 30 feet
operational.duration: Until the start of your next regular turn
operational.resolution: None. Re-evaluate the triggering attack against the chosen creature's increased AC; negate Magic Missile damage to that creature while the spell lasts.
operational.effect: The chosen creature gains +5 AC until the start of your next regular turn. During the same duration, Magic Missile cannot deal damage to that creature.
operational.scaling: None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.
operational.limitations: Does not protect against saving-throw effects, attacks that already resolved, or other automatically hitting effects unless explicitly named Magic Missile. Multiple Shield casts do not stack. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 blocks and catalog summaries are preserved alongside this card. Components use the existing class focus where Core says F or M/F; this focus interpretation is provisional. Exact target eligibility, duration endpoints, saves where absent, concentration where unclear and anti-loop limits are provisional integration decisions.  GPT conference correction: retain Core30ft range; self-only narrowing rejected. One willing recipient is a provisional target specification.

selectedOrdinarySpells.name: Detect Magic

operational.targets: Self; magical auras on creatures, objects, and active effects within 30 feet that you can perceive
operational.effect: For the duration, perceive the presence and visible outline of active magical auras within 30 feet. As an Action on a later turn, you may focus on one perceived aura to learn its broad magical school/category if that information is not protected.
operational.scaling: None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.
operational.limitations: Total cover and explicit anti-divination effects block detection. Does not reveal exact spell names, ranks, statistics, owners, motives, hidden curses, dormant magic, secret Director information, or mundane invisible creatures. Detecting an aura does not grant line of effect or permission to target through barriers. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 blocks and catalog summaries are preserved alongside this card. Components use the existing class focus where Core says F or M/F; this focus interpretation is provisional. Exact target eligibility, duration endpoints, saves where absent, concentration where unclear and anti-loop limits are provisional integration decisions. Core instantaneous metadata cannot sustain the described perception; this pilot uses explicit concentration for up to10minutes. The30ft range limits perception of spell-granted information.
operational.previousDraftDesignNotes: NEW provisional 10-minute concentration duration and two-step information model. Source 30-foot magical detection is preserved.

selectedOrdinarySpells.name: Mage Light

operational.targets: One unoccupied point you can perceive within range
operational.effect: Create one floating orb of harmless visible light at the chosen fixed point. It illuminates a 20-foot radius sufficiently for ordinary visual perception.
operational.limitations: You may have only one Mage Light orb active at a time; recasting ends the previous one. The orb is stationary after creation, creates no heat or damage, cannot blind, reveal invisibility by itself, ignite objects, trigger solar/light vulnerabilities unless they explicitly react to ordinary light, or serve as a physical object. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, 1-hour duration, and V/S components are retained. The source gives no illumination radius or movement procedure; a fixed 20-foot illumination radius and one-orb cap are NEW provisional mechanics.

selectedOrdinarySpells.name: Message

operational.targets: One creature you can perceive within range
operational.effect: Transmit one brief whispered message that could ordinarily be spoken during one Action directly to the target, so only it clearly hears the magical whisper.
operational.limitations: The spell does not grant a reply, language comprehension, mind reading, command authority, guaranteed identity verification, communication through total cover or an effect explicitly blocking magical communication, or transmission across planes. The target hears the actual words used and may respond only through ordinary means. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 120-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S components are retained. The 25-word cap, direct-hearing procedure, and no-reply boundary are NEW provisional mechanics because the source only says to whisper to a creature within 120 feet. Conference correction: remove unsupported25-word limit; one Action bounds ordinary speech.
